answer_2.quote: While metrics like LPIPS , CLIP-Score , and DreamSim  were proposed, they have certain limitations...

answer_3.quote: With such motivation, we introduce VIESCORE (Visual Instruction-guided Explainable Score), a framework to assess synthetic images in different conditional image generation tasks.

answer_4.quote: Recent works like ImagenHub , and HEIM  attempt to standardize human evaluation across various image generation tasks, though scalability remains a challenge.
answer_4.guideline: Images are rated in two aspects: (1) Semantic Consistency (SC) assesses how well the generated image aligns with the given conditions... (2) Perceptual Quality (PQ) evaluates the extent to which the generated image appears visually authentic and conveys a sense of naturalness.
